_doc: C-08 band file (02 s18.3: Dart vs Dart, both autopilot, 200 seeds, each side wins 45-55 %), on the R0 B.27 A-140 setup (AI-46): the pair 1,200 m apart nose to nose at 300 m AGL on the flat datum, both under the real DartBrain AUTO, one player per side and no doctrine (C08Rig.world), seeds 2k - 1 and 2k fly one seeded geometry with the sides and the spawn order swapped, cap_s 60. A duel is decided when exactly one Dart dies within cap_s; a ram (both die, 01 s3.1.3) and a timeout are draws. The test asserts decided >= min_decided and each side's share of the decided duels inside the band. `measured` pins the counts of the 200 fixed seeds as the hosted Linux runner measures them; a Windows desktop differs by 1 break-off (923 vs 924) in round 2 and by 1 duel / 0.15 % of the totals in round 1 (5,863 vs 5,856 rounds), because 60 s duels amplify the Windows vs Linux libm differences of the transcendental functions (cross-platform determinism is not required, 01 s7 ADR-03, 03 s5.6). The pin therefore holds within `tolerance` (duel counts +-4, totals +-1 %, about 6x the measured gap); any larger drift in DartBrain, the flight model or the gun is a deliberate JSON update. Per duel (AI-46 acceptance, round 2): rounds fired 30.8, of them with the true lead inside the 05 s6.2 fire cone 15.8 (51 %), hits 9.5 = 31 % of the rounds fired (02 s11.2 goal 12-18 % vs a manoeuvring Dart), EXTEND entries 5.7 of which break-offs 4.6, median time to the kill 36.1 s; 114 decided (59 / 55 = 51.8 / 48.2 %), 2 rams. Before AI-46 on this rig: 13 decided (6 / 7), 85 rams, 10.2 rounds, 6.2 in the cone, 3.5 hits, 4.9 EXTEND, 3.6 break-offs. GD-26's shipped setup (600 m, cap 15 s; its rig gave the FOE player the Vanguard doctrine) measured 199 of 200 draws with 487 rounds; AI-46 on that setup with this rig: 200 draws (no Dart dies inside 15 s), 3.9 rounds, 1.0 hits, 0 rams per duel (before: 2 decided, 49 rams, 2.8 rounds). Lives in test/sim/balance/ (A-138): sim_scenario.schema.json cannot hold these keys.
